generators.carrier: Mat (Fin 6) over C; permutations and unit-phase vectors

relations.statement: If H and K are monomial equivalent then HasRawQuartet H iff HasRawQuartet K.
A quartet of MUBs in Fin 6 exists iff some H has a raw quartet.

lemmas.statement: There exists a quartet of pairwise unbiased orthonormal bases of C^6 iff some 6x6 H has HasRawQuartet H.
lemmas.lean_skeleton: theorem L_quartet_iff_raw : (∃ B : Fin 4 → Mat (Fin 6), Quartet B) ↔ ∃ H : Mat (Fin 6), HasRawQuartet H := exists_quartet_iff_exists_rawQuartet

lemmas.statement: Raw-quartet existence is invariant under monomial equivalence (row and column permutations with phases).
lemmas.lean_skeleton: theorem L_invariance {H K : Mat ι} (h : MonomialEquivalent H K) : HasRawQuartet H ↔ HasRawQuartet K := hasRawQuartet_iff_of_monomialEquivalent h

near_misses.claim: Nonextension of a few concrete representatives excludes a quartet.
near_misses.rejecting_invariant: Global exclusion needs complete representative coverage of all Hadamard classes plus nonextension for each; no_quartet_of_concrete_representatives takes these as hypotheses.

open_obligations: Complete representative coverage of 6x6 complex Hadamard matrices is not grounded.
Nonextension for every representative is not grounded.
The signature of no_quartet_of_concrete_representatives is not given, so it is not cited in a lemma.
The definition of Quartet is not given in @SRC.
